import os,glob,re
def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def find_uniform_segments(row, min_length=6):
    """Find all contiguous horizontal segments of identical values >= min_length"""
    segments = []
    if len(row) == 0:
        return segments
    
    start = 0
    while start < len(row):
        end = start
        while end < len(row) and row[end] == row[start]:
            end += 1
        length = end - start
        if length >= min_length:
            segments.append((start, end - 1, row[start], length))
        start = end
    
    return segments
